concerns.text: The six 'Verified Datasets' listed (UCI HAR Test, UCI Shopper Train, UCI NLP Drop, Unsplash URLs, Reddit SYAC URLs, Malicious URLs) are primarily image/text URL collections and do not contain the required continuous numeric variables and categorical group labels needed for t‑test/ANOVA analysis. Using them would make FR‑001 and FR‑002 unattainable. Replace these with publicly available, numeric, tabular datasets that include a categorical group label (e.g., UCI 'Wine Quality', 'Breast Cancer Wisconsin', 'Iris', or similar OpenML classification/regression datasets) that satisfy the Shapiro‑Wilk, sample‑size, and missing‑value criteria.
